Description: The unprocessed matrix of read or fragment counts per feature (e.g., gene or transcript) per cell or sample, prior to any normalization, scaling, or batch correction.
A matrix of feature counts that has been adjusted (e.g., for sequencing depth or library size) to enable comparison across cells or samples.

A matrix of counts that has been further transformed (e.g., centered and/or scaled to unit variance) after normalization, typically used as input for downstream analyses such as dimensionality reduction or clustering.
A matrix of counts that has been adjusted to remove technical variation introduced by differences between sequencing batches or experimental runs, while preserving true biological signal.
